items.question: What is PrismTutor Studio?
items.answer: PrismTutor Studio is a premium coaching academy offering expert-crafted courses across all major subjects, grades, and exam tracks. We combine cutting-edge 3D-inspired teaching methods with personalized learning paths.

items.question: How are classes conducted?
items.answer: We offer three modes: Online (live video sessions), Offline (in-person at our centers), and Hybrid (combination of both). All modes include access to recorded sessions and study materials.

items.question: What grades do you cover?
items.answer: We offer courses from Grade 6 through Grade 12, including specialized tracks for competitive exams like JEE, NEET, Olympiads, and SAT.

items.question: How do I get started?
items.answer: Simply book a free demo session through our website. Our counselors will assess your needs and recommend the best learning path.

items.question: Can I take multiple courses simultaneously?
items.answer: Absolutely! Our Pro and Elite plans allow access to 3 or unlimited subjects respectively. We design schedules to avoid conflicts.

items.question: Are study materials provided?
items.answer: Yes, all courses include comprehensive study materials—PDFs, video lessons, practice sets, and previous year papers (where applicable).

items.question: What if I miss a live class?
items.answer: All live sessions are recorded and available for playback. Starter plan gets 30-day access, Pro gets 90-day, and Elite gets lifetime access.

items.question: How are doubts resolved?
items.answer: Pro and Elite students have access to dedicated doubt-clearing sessions. You can also post questions in our student portal for async support.

items.question: What device do I need for online classes?
items.answer: Any device with a stable internet connection, camera, and microphone—laptop, tablet, or smartphone. We recommend a laptop for the best experience.

items.question: Is there a mobile app?
items.answer: Our platform is fully responsive and works great on mobile browsers. A dedicated app is coming soon!

items.question: What if I face technical issues during a class?
items.answer: Our tech support team is available during all class hours. You can also access the recorded session at no extra cost.
